name: Dingwen Wu
bio: Dingwen Wu is a multi-disciplinary designer dedicated to the integrated, full-lifecycle design of architecture, landscape, and urban environments. From large-scale urban strategies to intimate human experiences, he believes that successful design emerges through the connection between vision and detail. He is particularly passionate about how grand urban narratives translate into tactical spatial experiences, maintaining a rigorous pursuit of meticulous detailing and spatial quality. Driven by a philosophy that space should resonate emotionally, Dingwen strives to create vibrant, living environments that foster meaningful human connections and evoke lasting memories.

Dingwen holds a Master of Landscape Architecture from the University of Pennsylvania, where he was awarded the prestigious ASLA Student Certificate of Honor. He earned his Bachelor of Architecture from Tongji University. Prior to his current practice, he has developed a global perspective through his experience working at internationally recognized design practices, including SWA New York, Field Operations, and !melk Landscape Architecture and Urban Design. His award-winning work has been recognized globally, receiving accolades such as the International Design Award (IDA), Muse Design Award (Silver), New York Architectural Design Award, and London Design Awards.
